# Say the bad news first

`customer_support.pb.de_escalation.say_the_bad_news_first` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Deliver bad news ourselves, early, before the customer discovers it or asks for it.

Bad news volunteered is evidence of control; the same news extracted is evidence of concealment. The content is identical and the effect on trust is opposite, which is why slipping a deadline quietly costs more than the slip itself.
